# ui commands

Every `ui` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `ui:mcp`

MCP server on stdio: ui_catalog, ui_schema, ui_validate, ui_render (ui:// HTML) for a visitor holding the --grant permissions.

```bash
bin/semitexa ui:mcp
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--grant` | yes |

## `ui:tree:catalog`

The components an agent may compose a screen from, for a visitor: manifest, --schema (whole-tree JSON Schema), --prompt (the compose prompt).

```bash
bin/semitexa ui:tree:catalog
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--grant` | yes |
| `--schema` | no |
| `--prompt` | no |
| `--json` | no |

## `ui:tree:compose`

Compose a screen from a description: model -> UI tree -> server check -> repair turns -> HTML (--scripted=reply1.json,reply2.json for no network).

```bash
bin/semitexa ui:tree:compose "<description>"
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--grant` | yes |
| `--scripted` | yes |
| `--rounds` | yes |
| `--json` | no |

## `ui:tree:render`

Check a UI tree for a visitor and draw it: the HTML, or every fault with its path and repair hint.

```bash
bin/semitexa ui:tree:render "<tree>"
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--grant` | yes |
| `--json` | no |

## `ui:tree:validate`

Check a UI tree against the catalog and a visitor's permissions; every fault with its path, expected value and repair hint.

```bash
bin/semitexa ui:tree:validate "<tree>"
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--grant` | yes |
| `--json` | no |
